question: Does a signed GF(2) affine-class solver exactly replay existing complete second public laws, and do the nine support/action pairs left by J8F satisfy the inherited five-variable-site gate?
scientific_boundary: Fixed ideal L=2 operator orbit, selected complete full-binary first public record and two fixed relation-free red-charge actions. This is a solver and site-count prerequisite, not a new all-support complete-law, private-error information, logical-risk, noisy-JIT, L=3, crossing or threshold study.

matrix.controls: All four J8D supports: base plus one representative from each of three winding classes, both actions. Recompute all singleton and all variable-site parity moments, invert Walsh to the existing complete second law, and require exact rational equality to every saved J8D row. These are replayed laws, not new laws.
matrix.unresolved: Exactly the nine J8C supports absent from the J8F completed prefix; both actions. Verify selected first mass, all 22 eligible second-site singleton means and actual variable-site counts only. Do not evaluate their pair/higher moments or complete second laws.
matrix.solver: Gaussian elimination over binary orbit-flip signatures returns one affine solution plus a kernel basis. Evaluate the signed ordered-product coefficient only on satisfying first-subset masks. If a second group anticommutes with a first projector, its conditional moment is exactly zero. Otherwise divide the signed affine sum by the first-projector signed sum. No character term outside the affine solution class is evaluated.
matrix.independent_unit: One deterministic private-error/selected-first-record/action exact control replay or singleton/site-count cell; no stochastic sampling unit or interval
matrix.integrity: Hash-pin every source/result and runner before/after. Verify the exact nine-support complement, public flux and action binding, first masses, J8G affine class sizes, 22 eligible second sites, 512 direct-moment spot checks, eight old complete-law replays, all resolved site gates and zero new complete laws/histories/arms/bootstraps. Fail closed on any mismatch.

acceptance: All four controls/eight prior complete laws replay exactly, including first mass, action-bound second flux, deterministic and variable sites, and every nonzero public charge row
Exactly nine previously unresolved supports/18 action cells receive exact first mass and 22 singleton means, with actual variable-site counts and a five-site gate
Combined signed-affine plus direct-moment work stays under the inherited 65,536-term cap and 60 CPU seconds
No new complete second law or private-error information, risk, noisy-JIT, L=3 or threshold inference
A passed prerequisite permits only separate preregistration of an all-support complete-law matrix, not its execution in this tick
stop_rule: Stop after the eight old-law replays and 18 new singleton/site-count cells, at first inherited cap, or immediately on any algebra, public-record, hash or replay failure. No new complete-law reconstruction or stochastic work.
